salvation.title: Salvation Verses
salvation.description: Essential verses about salvation, grace, and redemption through Jesus Christ.

verses.note: The most famous verse in the Bible - God's love and the gift of eternal life
All have sinned and fall short of God's glory
The wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life
God demonstrates His love - Christ died for us while we were still sinners
Confess with your mouth and believe in your heart
Whoever calls on the name of the Lord shall be saved
Saved by grace through faith, not by works
No other name under heaven by which we must be saved
If we confess our sins, He is faithful to forgive
In Christ, we are a new creation
Not by works of righteousness, but according to His mercy
Jesus is the way, the truth, and the life

comfort.title: Comfort and Peace
comfort.description: Verses that bring comfort, peace, and assurance in difficult times.

verses.note: The LORD is my shepherd - I shall not want
God is our refuge and strength, a very present help
Come to Me, all who are weary and burdened
Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you
Be anxious for nothing - the peace of God will guard your hearts
All things work together for good to those who love God
God of all comfort who comforts us in all our troubles
Fear not, for I am with you; I will strengthen and help you
The LORD is near to the brokenhearted
Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted
Cast all your anxiety on Him because He cares for you
God will wipe away every tear from their eyes

strength.title: Strength and Courage
strength.description: Verses about God's strength, courage in trials, and perseverance.

verses.note: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me
Those who wait on the LORD shall renew their strength
Be strong and courageous - the LORD your God is with you
God is our refuge and strength
My grace is sufficient - My strength is made perfect in weakness
Be strong in the Lord and in His mighty power
The joy of the LORD is your strength
The LORD is my light and salvation - whom shall I fear?
I will strengthen you and help you
Be strong and of good courage - He will not fail you

love.title: God's Love
love.description: Verses about God's unfailing love and our call to love others.

verses.note: God is love
For God so loved the world
God demonstrates His love - Christ died for us
Love is patient, love is kind - the nature of love
We love because He first loved us
I have loved you with an everlasting love
Nothing can separate us from the love of God
Greater love has no one than to lay down his life
Love the Lord your God and love your neighbor
See what great love the Father has lavished on us

prayer.title: Prayer and Communion
prayer.description: Verses about prayer, seeking God, and communion with Him.

verses.note: The Lord's Prayer - Our Father who art in heaven
Be anxious for nothing, but in everything by prayer
Pray without ceasing
The prayer of a righteous person is powerful and effective
Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find
This is the confidence we have in approaching God
Call to Me and I will answer you
The LORD is near to all who call upon Him
Whatever you ask in prayer, believing, you will receive
Continue steadfastly in prayer, being watchful

faith.title: Faith and Trust
faith.description: Verses about faith, trust in God, and believing His promises.

verses.note: Faith is the substance of things hoped for
Trust in the LORD with all your heart
Whatever you ask in prayer, believe that you have received it
Faith comes by hearing the word of God
Without faith it is impossible to please God
We walk by faith, not by sight
Faith as small as a mustard seed can move mountains
Faith by itself, if it does not have works, is dead
The life I now live, I live by faith in the Son of God
Commit your way to the LORD; trust in Him

promises.title: God's Promises
promises.description: Key promises God has made to His people throughout Scripture.

verses.note: I know the plans I have for you - plans to prosper you
All things work together for good
I will never leave you nor forsake you
I am with you always, even to the end of the age
I go to prepare a place for you
My God shall supply all your need
Perfect peace to those whose mind is stayed on You
No temptation beyond what you can bear
If My people pray, I will heal their land
Whoever calls on the name of the LORD shall be saved

wisdom.title: Wisdom and Guidance
wisdom.description: Verses about seeking wisdom, God's guidance, and making wise choices.

verses.note: If any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask God
Trust in the LORD and He will direct your paths
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom
Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path
The LORD gives wisdom; from His mouth come knowledge
Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly
Wisdom is the principal thing; get wisdom
I will instruct you and teach you in the way you should go
Your ears shall hear a word: This is the way, walk in it
Commit your works to the LORD and your plans will succeed

hope.title: Hope and Assurance
hope.description: Verses about hope, eternal life, and confident expectation in God.

verses.note: May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace
Plans to give you hope and a future
This hope we have as an anchor of the soul
Hope in God, for I shall yet praise Him
Hope does not disappoint
A living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ
His mercies are new every morning
Looking for the blessed hope and appearing of our God
My soul, wait silently for God; my hope is from Him
We were saved in this hope

forgiveness.title: Forgiveness and Mercy
forgiveness.description: Verses about God's forgiveness and our call to forgive others.

verses.note: If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive
Be kind and forgiving, as God in Christ forgave you
Forgive as the Lord forgave you
If you forgive others, your Father will forgive you
As far as the east is from the west, He has removed our sins
I am He who blots out your transgressions
He will cast all our sins into the depths of the sea
Repent and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out
I acknowledged my sin and You forgave the iniquity
He who is forgiven much, loves much
